run_process_s3_logs_cli: run the script to extract S3 tar.gz logs and parse Turk interaction CSVs from a directory
run_read_s3_bucket: run read_s3_bucket to extract logs.tar.gz archives from an S3-synced directory into an output folder
run_read_turk_logs: run read_turk_logs to crawl and concatenate pipe-delimited CSV files from a Turk output directory
run_get_stats: run get_stats to compute deduplication rate, average command length, and valid command ratio for a list
review_read_turk_logs: review read_turk_logs to understand how it extracts turk_log_id and concatenates CSV dataframes
